title: From Attention to Customers

Ten substantial chapters double as course modules, with an exact hour ledger and 100 ten-hour sessions.
Length proxy: at least 5,000 whitespace-separated words per chapter; an authorized model tokenizer was unavailable. Exact model-token counts will not be claimed.
deliverables: Standalone HTML reading edition with embedded interactive labs
Offline browser companion and readable source
Research ledger, verification report, portable ZIP
platform_baseline: Official public guidance inspected November 13, 2026; account-specific tools, pricing, eligibility and UI labels require rechecking in the learner's account.
chapters: Websites, email, digital products, and launches
workflow: Sequential authoring; canonical chapters first; generate book/reader/session ledger; verify browser and calculations; save deliverables.
